Package com.csse3200.game.components.friendlynpc

Class NpcInteractionEvents

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.friendlynpc.NpcInteractionEvents
public final class NpcInteractionEvents extends Object
Event contract between the friendly NPC system and the dialogue and cutscene systems.

All events are triggered on, and listened for on, the player entity's event handler, because the player outlives rooms and NPCs.

Outgoing (this system → other systems):

  • START_DIALOGUE (String dialogueId, Entity npc)
  • START_CUTSCENE (String cutsceneId, Entity npc)
  • INTERACTION_STARTED (String npcId, Entity npc)
  • INTERACTION_FINISHED (String npcId, Entity npc)
  • INTERACTION_CANCELLED (String npcId, Entity npc)

Incoming (other systems → this system):

  • DIALOGUE_FINISHED (String dialogueId): the dialogue has closed.
  • CUTSCENE_FINISHED (String cutsceneId): the cutscene has ended.
  • DIALOGUE_CUTSCENE_CUE (String dialogueId): optional; start a DURING_DIALOGUE cutscene now.

Player controls stay locked until the relevant "finished" event arrives, so the dialogue and cutscene systems must always send it, including when the player skips.

On the NPC entity itself, INDICATOR_SHOWN and INDICATOR_HIDDEN (no arguments) fire when the NPC becomes, or stops being, the one the player can interact with.
